text: Mozzart (Mozzart d.o.o. Beograd), KK Partizan's title sponsor since 2022, is a Serbian private company.
short: Mozzart is a Serbian private company; the club's own announcement says so.

source.name: KK Partizan: KK Partizan Mozzart Bet - Novo ime za nove pobede!
source.quote: U novu sezonu, crno-beli ulaze sa novim naslovnim sponzorom. U pitanju je srpska privatna kompanija, a to je Mozzart.
source.note: Club announcement of the naming sponsorship: calls Mozzart a Serbian private company. Register detail: CompanyWall's ownership page for Mozzart d.o.o. (checked by hand 2026-10-01) lists 36 owners - Jadranka Stepanović 40,98%, Dejan Čakajac 38,35%, Eter Consulting d.o.o. 2,64%, the rest individuals with 1,5% or less each; the page currently serves scripts a stub, so the register list can no longer be quoted here.
